project.name: TRAMS :: Common Contracts
project.description:
The published integration contract between event producers and consumers: the event envelope, user event payloads, and the broker topology names.
This module deliberately contains no framework code, no entities and no utilities. A shared library that grows beyond the wire contract is how a set of microservices quietly turns back into a distributed monolith, so the scope here is kept to what both sides must agree on by definition.
